name: Psychic Projection
description: Projects an invulnerable copy of this unit onto a tile within %cast_range% tiles for %duration% turns.
details: Projecting costs no action - it is as free as a step.
The copy moves and attacks freely and takes no damage.
This unit is stunned for as long as the copy exists.

upgrade.summary: The copy stays indefinitely, and this unit is no longer stunned holding it.
upgrade.description: Projects an invulnerable copy of this unit onto a tile within %cast_range% tiles, and leaves it standing for as long as it is wanted.
details: Projecting costs no action - it is as free as a step.
The copy moves and attacks freely and takes no damage.
This unit acts as normal the whole time the copy is out.
Casting it again relocates the copy rather than raising a second one.
